what: SD3-Medium full fine-tuning: peak GPU memory and step time, measured by 3-step smoke runs
recipe: fp32 master weights, bf16 autocast, gradient checkpointing, batch 1 x accum 4, 512 px

runs.note: OOM on step 2, when 8-bit Adam allocates its state
paging the optimizer state to CPU costs 2.2x in speed

conclusion: Full fine-tuning needs a 40GB+ GPU at full speed, or a 24GB GPU with a paged optimizer at roughly half the speed. Loss curves match (0.348 -> 0.244 over 3 steps) either way.
